notes.title: Back to School 2025 & Patch #4
notes.content:
Hello everyone, I hope you had a relaxing summer!

Back to School 2025

To start the new school year, DOLOS is being part of the Back To School Games Celebration, which showcases educational and brain-teasing games, as well as games about school itself! That's where DOLOS comes in :)

The event is taking place on Steam from August 25 to September 1. All kinds of games await you, so don't hesitate to check it out! We thank  Mooncube Games for their invitation, as well as the game  Spirit City Lofi and Lofi Girl for co-hosting this 2025 edition!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120028/8dc906c2acdadbe0be75855c4454bb6d6feacbab.png

Health is important

We'd like to take this opportunity to give you some news. One of the development team members experienced health issues over the summer. Nothing serious, but it needs to be taken care of. This has caused delays in development, which has forced us to change our short-term plans, particularly for the Back To School festival. 

Since we didn't want to come empty-handed, we still prepared a little something for you. 
But let's just say we're coming with a smaller patch than expected!

A 4th small patch for 2nd demo


Visual changes to the main menu
DOLOS Phase 1: minor visual improvements to the list of applicants.


Bolder fonts.
New selection button.
Diploma information replaced by the applicant's social background.
Counters for complementary files (dropped and total) per applicant.

DOLOS Phase 2: overhaul of how the professional trainings are generated.


Any pro wish can be fulfilled by an existing pro recommendation in the deck. 
Greater chances for pro wishes & reco to be duplicated.
If a priority applicant (those from Exodolos) have both pro reco & wish, they will be identical (except rare cases).
If a non-priority applicant (not from Exodolos) have both pro reco & wish, they will be different (except rare cases).
Many minor bugs fixed.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120028/847dd41964d1664402c503c4750b1bc845ea6629.png
Visit our Steam page to play our demo and add DOLOS to your wishlist if you enjoy the game, it helps us greatly.

See you next time for a bigger patch!

notes.title: DOLOS: Your Best Future Demo - Patch 3
notes.content:
DOLOS: Your Best Future is exhibited for AG French Direct 2025, an annual event celebrating French video games organized by ActuGaming. We're thrilled to be back since our first appearance in 2023.

To discover:

May 28 at 6pm (CEST) on Youtube: a live showcase of trailers, interviews and mashups on the ActuGaming channel. VOD will be available later.
From May 28 to June 2 on Steam: a Steam page featuring some fifty games, including 25 exclusive demos!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120028/9e8f58bb38004583420bb475c65c8193b198bd24.png

What about DOLOS? :o

What better way to mark the occasion than with a major patch to the second DOLOS: Your Best Future demo!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120028/6c818d8f4ccf5c7c9f9b6b8326bfac2c2e7db0d5.png

Card game: new look and difficulty

Among the fixes and modifications:


New look for the 2 central gauges: the bonus gauge and the external gauge.
The segments of the 2 gauges are called bonus points (BP) and external points (EP).
Assign an applicant gives 5 possible results: 


perfect (+2 BP)
good (+1 BP)
mediocre (+1 BP and +1 EP)
bad (+1 EP)
worse (+2 EP)

Time bonuses and maluses become a gauge completion reward.
Picking applicants becomes a gauge completion reward.
Receiving external applicants becomes a gauge completion reward.
Gauge level is displayed all the time.
All gauge completion rewards are displayed all the time.
The good assignment combo becomes the perfect assignment streak. It yields +1 BP. 
Even a good assignment ends the streak.
The number of all remaining places is displayed at the top of the universities.
Many visual improvements in colors, feedbacks and animations.


In general, it should be harder for your turn to last longer.
You start with less time, times bonuses are rarer, less “exponential”. 
The goal is the players faces the turn ends more often, and so the external applicants.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120028/5d7a229ed22a43e4f8f324b25090f48bc6c7b189.png

In-between turns: a strategic break

Between the turns you can breathe a little bit!
But that's not all: you can think about what to do next.


The in-between turns displays the total number of places remaining.
The in-between turns displays more clearly the turn modifiers, i.e. unique perk for the next turn.
Modifiers are currently scripted. There's the Preparation modifier only for the first turn and 3 other modifiers for  the Sold-Out Turn. Other modifiers are of course planned.
The deck view is only available during in the in-between turns.
The deck view displays the draw order of the applicants in the deck. In other words, you can see which applicants you're going to draw first.
The deck view also displays all the applicants' wishes and all the DOLOS recommendations.
All the time spent in the in-between turns doesn't cost EXP.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120028/0589c060d1f47eb33db2292366deca20c9d70238.png

Two difficulty modes

Finally, the demo's notorious problem of starting the adventure on level 3 gave us the idea of creating two difficulty modes, one specifically for the first playthrough of the game.

Discovery mode will simulate the difficulty of the first level on the DOLOS application.
Specifically

in PHASE 1, you'll only have to deal with 4 different complementary files,
in PHASE 2, there are +30% more university places,
in PHASE 2, a game turn starts at 60 seconds.

Note: the difficulty is still high, as you'll still be confronted with more dilemmas via the EXODOLOS application (which won't be the case in the “real” Level 1).

Normal mode is aligned with level 3 difficulty. 
So

in PHASE 1, you'll deal with 9 different complementary files, including the 3 “new” ones on level 3, which are more heavily represented than the others.
in PHASE 2, there are +15% university places,
in PHASE 2, a game turn starts at 30 seconds.


This is the first version of these difficulty modes, changes are to be expected.
A third difficulty mode is planned for the final game.

Discord and playtest

We'd like to end this big post by reminding you of the existence of our Discord!
This is the place to join it if you'd like to chat with us, give us your feedback, preview announcements and take part in exclusive playtests!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120028/bdc6c0b3be1d9748af05ec4528fe5c35bb1e35ba.png

Speaking of playtesting, a big public session has been postponed for quite some time now.
This is linked to all the balancing work on the card game, which we felt was more important.

Nevertheless, a playtest session is still planned. Once all the additions to the card game have been integrated (we're almost there), we'll keep you posted all over our networks.

Thank you all for following us and giving us your feedback, it gives us a lot of strength in everyday life! 
<3 <3 <3 

See you soon!

The Playing Paradigms team

notes.title: DOLOS: Your Best Future Demo - Patch 2
notes.content:
Hello DOLOS operators! A series of fixes have just been added to the demo of DOLOS: Your Best Future!

Among the bug fixes:


EXP can now be spent to block the pro training during the sold out turn,
no more bugs on the last applicants drawn in PHASE 2,
the “Hit the nail on the head” challenge from PHASE 1 works normally,
no more “black training” bug, a bug that appeared when PHASE 2 offered at least 10 university trainings.

Visual improvements have also been added:


in PHASE 2, the deck gauges (bonus and external cards) animate at each progression,
in PHASE 2, each applicant's recommendations and wishes appear directly on the trainings through animated and dynamic icons,
DOLOS challenge animation no longer shakes like before.

The next demo patch will bring 3 important strategic features to PHASE 2, one of which many of you have been asking for! 

The DOLOS PHASE 2 playtest will start right after the release of the next patch.

See you for the 3rd patch!

notes.title: DOLOS: Your Best Future Demo - Patch 1
notes.content:
Since last Thursday we've fixed a series of bugs in the narrative progression of the 2nd DEMO of DOLOS: Your Best Future!

Among the bugs fixed:

the destinies of [spoiler]Samantha, Nabil and Sophie[/spoiler] update in EXODOLOS when they are selected or oriented,
the loss of money caused by retro-control in the final ranking only applies [spoiler]if you have helped Samantha, Nabil or Sophie[/spoiler],
the ending cutscene [spoiler]varies correctly according to Nabil's destiny[/spoiler],
the list of priority applicants on EXODOLOS updates correctly during DOLOS' phase 2,
EXODOLOS continues to display correctly after the final ranking of DOLOS' operators,
messages from Marie regarding [spoiler]your choices on the destinies of Samantha, Nabil and Sophie[/spoiler] are not missing anymore,
returning to the main menu from the pause menu works.


See you next week for a patch dedicated only to DOLOS' phase 2!

notes.title: A 2nd DEMO IS OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Hello operators!
Today is a big day for us!

On the occasion of our participation in the Storyteller's Festival 2025 on Steam, we are happy to announce that a brand new demo is available on the DOLOS: Your Best Future Steam page!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120028/facbe42aa4565932290017e36b705bb709e95e8e.png

• A complete game level

We invite you to dive back into the third level of the adventure, this time fully available!

You'll discover


Enhanced content of the first demo like better feedbacks, new complementary files in DOLOS' PHASE 1,
DOLOS' PHASE 2, a card game in which you must quickly assign your applicants to trainings,
more dialog choices and more advanced conversations on the Concord application,
optional press articles on the News application,
and much more!
 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120028/07a241b76d3b30b79af17bae86160abe5836297c.png

• Regular updates

We plan to regularly update the demo content in order to refine the vanilla gaming experience as much as possible!

A number of fixes are already in the pipeline for both phases of DOLOS, particularly in terms of balancing and readability.

See you in the coming weeks to follow all this in the form of patch notes!

• 3rd playtest session coming soon

Would you like to give us your opinion? Or ask us questions about the game?
Join our Discord community to get in touch with the development team and follow development more closely!

After a few updates to the demo - within a few weeks - we'll be organizing a 3rd playtest on our Discord. This will take the form of a play session accompanied by a short questionnaire focusing on PHASE 2 of DOLOS.

We look forward to seeing you soon!

notes.title: Opening of the 2nd Playtest session
notes.content:
Hello dear operators!

We're searching for testers to play a gameplay demo of DOLOS: Your Best Future!

Let's remember that playtesting a game means to accept

[olist]
playing an experimental, unfinished version of the game,
being spoiled of some elements (mechanical or narrative),
answering questions on an online form after playing the game.[/olist]
If, after all that, you're still interested in giving us that little helping hand, you can join our Discord server where everything is very well explained.

Some useful information about this playtest session :


Duration: 50 minutes (play game and fill the form)
Playtest availability : 1 month starting today
Machine and system: PC, Windows
Languages: English and French
Subject: testing 10 different complementary files (PHASE 1 of DOLOS)
Specificity: short gameplay demo without narration
It is recommended that you have already played the game at least once (Steam demo or other).
Playtest or not, we'd like to thank you for following the game's development in ever-growing numbers. 

See you soon!

notes.title: DEVLOG #1 : a look back at the demo and LudoNarraCon
notes.content:
LudoNarraCon & Greetings!

Many of you discovered DOLOS: Your Best Future during LudoNarraCon. More than 2,000 users wishlisted the game and around 600 played the demo!

Many thanks for this!  PHASE 1 of DOLOS
PHASE 1 is a management game in which you have to increase applicants' potential in order to reach a required average. In the game world, this is the phase in which you feed DOLOS with data, the complementary files. Applicants' scores are, according to DOLOS, their chances of succeeding in a given course (in the demo, Law). New data will come into play as you progress through the game's story.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120028/ccadb65aa85c784ebc99a4b9128d306a521684a6.gif

The heart of the game is these complementary files: you have to guess which ones are likely to increase the potential. Each type of file has its own way of working which you need to understand by observing all its variations: variable values (3 or 0 subscription(s)), variable words (of good or bad quality) or even an addition of the two.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120028/6d3ea7bcf8155e2fd0a48959c74f2fa83b955331.gif

With the exception of the 3 EXODOLOS applicants, all applicant information is procedurally generated. So if you start a game again, you'll never find the same applicants, and you'll never be asked for the same average. In the demo, only Nabil, Samantha and Sophie's scores remain the same, but we're working on adapting them too, to keep the difficulty extremely controlled.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120028/298b45c589b7672729ac0eda3ef28f539a3efe99.gif

At present, it may be very difficult, if not impossible, to select the 3 EXODOLOS applicants in PHASE 1.

> EXP in DOLOS
It's a bit like your health points but in a company. If you're at 0 EXP or below at the end of a level (after PHASE 1 and 2), you're kicked out of Dolos Incorporated, you have to start the whole level over (game over).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120028/95462e77887a86151e07fa8c6587e58dab593642.png

EXP is lost or gained depending on the results at the end of each PHASE.
To summarize


the faster you play and the more strictly you follow the rules, the more EXP you earn,
the slower you play and bypass the rules, the more EXP you lose.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120028/75c4624c818c631b6ad95cb2b33db6cd261372e1.gif

Finally, EXP is also earned by completing challenges, which are ingame (diegetic) achievements that increase in difficulty with each completion.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120028/cdb76d0793ae89b5bb9fc61eab57ceb74c3bcd1a.gif

> Chatting on CONCORD
Most dialogues on CONCORD remain optional, as you don't need to read every message to advance the game. Better still, the characters you're chatting with aren't waiting for you. Our aim with CONCORD is to create a narrative as real time as possible, and in line with your actions in DOLOS.

Indeed, in the demo, your interlocutor reacts differently depending on how many EXODOLOS applicants you've selected, but it's just as possible not to download EXODOLOS, whether out of disagreement or forgetfulness, leading to other narrative branches.

Also, not responding is a choice like any other, with its own set of consequences. For example, by ignoring your interlocutor, he or she may be prompted to follow up, change the subject or just stop the conversation altogether. This is an important rule that we try to apply throughout the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120028/97c33ea911752235036eab38827f421763b57d91.gif

Finally, you'll chat with more than one character in the final game. Already in the demo, the identity of the interlocutor is not the same according to your choices in the main menu. As the game is still in development, we plan to improve certain aspects of the dialogue system, to make it even more readable and dynamic.

> EXODOLOS and influencing DOLOS
EXODOLOS is the 4th application in the game, available from level 3, the demo level.
There's no need to download EXODOLOS, and you can even finish the whole game without it.

It's thanks to (or because of) EXODOLOS that the game becomes difficult.

Basically, each level asks you to help certain applicants disadvantaged by DOLOS who, without your intervention, will be working for life in jobs they didn't choose.


Helping them means committing deviations in your work, which can cost you EXP in DOLOS (and get fired at worst case scenario).
But helping them takes the scenario in other directions, starting with the future of these applicants, which is no longer the one foreseen by DOLOS.

What will you choose?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120028/3996ca55af8deb801aa3979e9dc3158a6dcd2353.gif

Among the EXODOLOS applicants are the decisive applicants (in the demo, Nabil, Samantha and Sophie). Like an "EXODOLOS' main quest", you receive a lot of biographical information about their lives. You may (or may not) feel empathy and a sense of injustice towards these applicants, which may (or may not) make you want to respect their wishes and thus fight internally against DOLOS. There will be around ten decisive applicants in the full game, and the fate of each of them will evolve according to your choices and as you progress through the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120028/ac2f5dccaff895008559acd7c40372873a7efaad.gif

In addition, on the "Influences" tab, EXODOLOS delivers a more extensive list of these applicants, sorted according to their level of priority. Together, these applicants can lead the DOLOS learning algorithm to different narrative branches.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120028/532c5dd700b24bccb7cd29e379ed7e944b93d8dd.gif

We're planning a "full-screen" mode for reading the biographies of the decisive applicants, as well as audio playback. But overall, EXODOLOS is the most finalized part of the game today.

What's next?

We're working on several projects at once.

But the most worrying of these is testing several levels in a row - the first ones - in order to

produce a more initiatory demo,
develop the save system,
integrate and test the dialogues at the beginning of the game (already written).

In addition, each level has its share of micro-evolutions (such the new complementary files in PHASE 1) and therefore its bunch of micro-tests.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120028/5e2f7e5bd3a2a88d58cd7deb5e74e2593c898bfa.gif

At the same time, we're correcting PHASE 2. Some elements will be simplified, while others will be added to increase the strategic aspect of the phase.
Most of you don't know it yet, but we can't wait to show it off!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120028/923fd5951a1ad335772375fe5f81eec29680b217.gif

The NEWS AGGREGATOR application will also be revealed in the next demo. It's been working well for a long time, but we'll have to come back to it to simplify the integration of translations (and therefore simplify the display a little too).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120028/bca0f9fa66682556ce79ef91f68dbfc7eb245bf1.gif

Finally, in the shorter term, we're planning a number of improvements to the features discussed in this devlog. So get ready for at least one update of the current demo.. The next devlog will cover this topic.

Until the next one!

The Playing Paradigms team

the first trailer of DOLOS: Your Best Future, also available here.
demo's gameplay with Farah's commentary, available for free on our Steam page.
